keyEvents.text: Delay in match (Barcelona).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Barcelona 1, Racing de Santander 0. João Cancelo (Barcelona) right footed shot from outside the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Lamine Yamal.
Pedro Felipe (Racing de Santander) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Barcelona 2, Racing de Santander 0. Raphinha (Barcelona) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Barcelona 2, Racing de Santander 1. Maguette Gueye (Racing de Santander) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Asier Villalibre.
Own Goal by Asier Villalibre, Racing de Santander. Barcelona 3, Racing de Santander 1.
Goal! Barcelona 4, Racing de Santander 1. Raphinha (Barcelona) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Dani Olmo.
Penalty saved. Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) left footed shot saved in the bottom right corner by Julen Agirrezabala (Racing de Santander).
Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Barcelona. Wojciech Szczesny replaces Joan García because of an injury.
Delay in match because of an injury Pedro Felipe (Racing de Santander).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
